entries.description: AT-928 WAL dedup (NOOP on duplicate intent_hash) is not enforceable within S2-001. S2-001 provides the hash prerequisite; a downstream WAL integration story must implement and test the dedup logic.
entries.resolution_criteria: An integration test exists that: (1) writes an intent to WAL, (2) attempts to write a second intent with the same hash, (3) asserts NOOP behavior.
entries.notes: R1 identified this as a cross-story dependency. R2 confirmed P1 priority. The hash function itself is PROVEN (AT-218, AT-343); only the WAL integration proof is missing.

entries.description: compute_intent_hash has zero production callers. The function is PROVEN-UNIT but not PROVEN-INTEGRATED. A downstream story must call compute_intent_hash from a production code path.
entries.resolution_criteria: grep -r 'compute_intent_hash' crates/soldier_core/src/ returns at least one production-code (non-test) caller.
entries.notes: Expected for building-block stories. The function is exported via pub mod idempotency. Integration is downstream.
